title: Device
description: Identity of the pad and where its database entry and mapping live. Read by Core.swift (DeviceSpec) and Install.swift. File: data/device.json.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the wizard, e.g. "GameSir G7 Pro (Bluetooth mode)".

vendorID.description: USB/Bluetooth vendor ID as a decimal integer. GameSir is 13623 (0x3537). The database entry matches on it.

productID.description: Product ID as a decimal integer. The G7 Pro in Bluetooth mode is 4130 (0x1022). The database entry matches on it.

identifier.description: Reverse-DNS identifier for our entry in Apple's GameControllers-Custom.bundle Info.plist, e.g. "com.GameSir.G7Pro.Bluetooth". install/uninstall find the entry by this string.

compatibilityVersion.description: Value Apple's database uses to gate personality features. Copy it from an existing entry; "10.1.36" matches the GameSir X3 entry we derive from.

personalityTemplate.description: Repo-relative path to the personality plist the wizard rewrites, e.g. "personality/GameSir-G7Pro-Bluetooth.plist".

personalityInstallPath.description: Path inside the Custom bundle where the personality is installed, e.g. "Personalities/GameSir/G7Pro/Bluetooth.plist". The Info.plist entry references it.

notes.description: Free-text facts about the pad for humans. Not read by code.
